title: agent.claude_agent_sdk.Agent
description: A validated Claude Agent SDK Agent with its computed content-addressed ID.

client_objectiveai_mcp.description:
Client-side ObjectiveAI MCP surface the calling client is
expected to expose locally back to the API (objectiveai
built-in, plus specific plugins / tools by owner+name+version).

effort.description: The effort level for model output.

id.description: The deterministic content-addressed ID (22-character base62 string).

laboratories.description:
Laboratories provisioned for the agent — each becomes a
client-side laboratory MCP server whose id DERIVES from the
agent's full id plus the spec (see
[`laboratories::derived_id`](super::super::laboratory::laboratories::derived_id)).

mcp_servers.description: MCP servers the agent can connect to.

output_mode.description: The output mode for vector completions. Ignored for agent completions.

prefix_content.description: Rich content prepended to the user's prompt.

suffix_content.description: Rich content appended after the user's prompt.

thinking.description:
Whether thinking/extended thinking is enabled.

Defaults to `true`. Set to `false` to disable.
